[[File:Northan.png|alt=Three black eagles on a background of gray|thumb|Sign of House Northan]]
'''House Northan''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Its [[High Seat]] is the 16 years old Lord  [[Conail Northan]].

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Northan is three black eagles, known as the Eagles, or the Black Eagles.{{ref/book|twotc}} Its battle cry is "The Eagles!"

==Activities==
During the [[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]], House Northan was one of the first six Houses to support [[House Trakand]] for the [[Lion Throne]].{{ref/book|10|13}}
